current_task.title: Estimate Wizard UI Redesign
current_task.instruction: Do not implement yet. First read and understand this specification. Report your implementation plan and wait for Architect approval.

purpose.main: Replace the current long-scroll Estimate Editor with a step-based wizard UI.
purpose.reason: Improve usability and reduce operator fatigue. This is an operation-flow/UI redesign only.
not_purpose: Do not add new business features.
Do not change existing OCR logic.
Do not change existing PDF logic.
Do not change existing LINE logic.

absolute_rules: Implement only what is explicitly written in this specification.
Do not redesign beyond this specification.
Do not simplify or reinterpret the workflow.
If anything is unclear, stop and ask the Architect.
Preserve current customer and vehicle save logic.
Preserve the current sticky subtotal/total window on the right side.

target_change.from: One long scrolling Estimate Editor screen
target_change.scope: UI flow and screen structure only

wizard_flow.name: Customer Registration
requirements: New customer registration must be the default.
Existing customer search must be available.
Vehicle registration certificate OCR AI input must remain available.
LINE ID acquisition via QR code must be available.
Postal-code-to-address lookup must be available.
Business customer settings must use the current existing rules.
AI/OCR confirmation rules must remain unchanged.

wizard_flow.name: Vehicle Registration
requirements: Vehicle registration OCR AI input must remain available.
Vehicle fields must remain the same as the current implementation.
Body size must be auto-estimated from the 3M total size logic.
Body size selection buttons must be displayed.
Operator must be able to manually select or correct body size.

wizard_flow.name: Service Category Selection
requirements: Multiple categories can be selected.
Only selected categories must appear in the next service content step.
Use intuitive illustrated buttons.

wizard_flow.name: Service Content Input
requirements: Display only the service sections selected in Step 3.
If Coating is selected, show the coating section.
If PPF is selected, show the PPF section.
If Window Film is selected, show the window film section.
If Body Regular Maintenance is selected, show the body maintenance section.
If Car Wash is selected, show the car wash section.
If Room Cleaning is selected, show the room cleaning section.
If Other Work is selected, show the other work section.
PPF partial work must keep the current approved behavior and settings.
Store-specific option items must be shown only when configured in store settings.
Default example option items should exist in initial settings.

wizard_flow.name: Discount and Coupon
requirements: Discount can be entered as amount.
Discount can be entered as percentage.
Coupons registered in store settings must be selectable.
Current discount calculation logic must be preserved.

wizard_flow.name: Notes and Internal Memo
requirements: Customer-facing note must be shown on the estimate.
Internal memo must be saved only as internal record.
Customer-facing note and internal memo must be clearly separated.

wizard_flow.name: Final Review and Actions
requirements: Show the created estimate content.
Display action buttons.
Cancel must not auto-save.
All actions except Cancel must auto-save before executing.

buttons.label: 修正
buttons.behavior: Return to the relevant wizard step for editing.

buttons.label: PDF作成
buttons.behavior: Auto-save first, then use the existing PDF generation flow.

buttons.label: LINE送信_or_LINE文章コピー
buttons.behavior: Auto-save first, then follow LINE behavior rules.

buttons.label: 予約日を決めてカレンダー登録
buttons.behavior: Auto-save first, then use the existing calendar/reservation flow if available.

common_rule: The message must include default greeting text and estimate content.
The default greeting text must be editable later in store settings.

if_line_business_account_configured.behavior: Send directly using the existing LINE integration.

if_line_business_account_not_configured.behavior: Generate copyable LINE message text for manual sending.

do_not_change: Do not create new LINE integration logic unless explicitly approved.
Do not remove the existing LINE integration.

desktop: Keep the current sticky subtotal/total window on the right side.
tablet: Also provide Next and Back buttons.
mobile: Also provide Next and Back buttons.

requirements: Keep the current sticky subtotal/total display.
Do not remove it.
It should remain useful throughout the wizard flow where applicable.

allowed: Reorganizing existing EstimateEditor UI into steps

required_first_response_from_claude.instruction: Before writing code, summarize your understanding and create an implementation plan.
must_include: How existing logic will be preserved

acceptance_criteria: Current long-scroll Estimate Editor is replaced by step-based wizard UI.
Customer step works with current customer logic.
Vehicle step works with current vehicle/OCR logic.
Service category selection controls which service sections appear.
Only selected service sections are displayed for estimate input.
Discount/coupon step works with current logic.
Notes and internal memo are separated.
Final review displays estimate contents and action buttons.
Mobile/tablet navigation supports swipe and buttons.
final_instruction: Do not implement immediately. First provide the implementation plan and wait for Architect approval.
